data.title: 红月卡莲 · 暮色窗扉前的战意与温存
data.action: 背靠着落地窗玻璃席地而坐，单膝竖起，手肘搭在膝盖上勾着一件薄外衫，酒红碎发垂额，眼神带着不服输的微羞，直直对视着眼前之人。
data.location: 现代高层公寓落地窗前，俯瞰夕阳下渐渐点亮的新东京霓虹天际线
data.lighting: 暮色残阳将天空染成紫红色，余晖在修长肌理与玻璃反光上镀上一层熔金色泽
data.mood: 飒爽战士卸下盔甲后的柔情与倔强，热烈而克制
data.description: 现代高层公寓落地窗前，俯瞰夕阳下渐渐点亮的新东京霓虹天际线。背靠着落地窗玻璃席地而坐，单膝竖起，手肘搭在膝盖上勾着一件薄外衫，酒红碎发垂额，眼神带着不服输的微羞，直直对视着眼前之人。 她微微抬眸轻语——“看什么看……在战场之外，我也是个正常的女人吧？别露出那种不可思议的表情啊，笨蛋。”
data.promptProse: Seen from a low angle against the floor-to-ceiling glass of a modern high-rise apartment overlooking the glowing dusk skyline, Kallen sits on the floor with one knee drawn up and an elbow propped over it holding a thin jacket, meeting the viewer's gaze with proud, flushed candor.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the apartment floor with her back against the panoramic sunset window overlooking neon-lit skyscrapers, she hooks a light jacket over one raised knee and meets the viewer's eyes with a defiant blush in a scarlet criss-cross sheer athletic bralette and boyleg briefs.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep scarlet silk-and-mesh athletic lingerie set with wide criss-cross waist straps across her toned midriff and fitted boyleg briefs.
